name: Saeki Makoto
source:
Head of the Design office at the printing company "Sekigawa Printers"
With his gentle demeanor and polite way of speaking he's a gentleman with many fans inside and outside of the office.
He's a former colleague of the protagonists father, because of this he want's to help the protagonist like a beloved daughter.
